The '''Kage''' were a pale-skinned [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the caverns in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]]. The Kage had a long-time conflict with the [[Belugan/Legends|Belugans]] and were opposed to them. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] ordered the capture of [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]] to marry her, she was later given back to the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]] and Pluma Sodi were known members of this species.

==Society and culture==
The Kage were a spirited and dedicated people. Their most powerful combatants,<ref name=":0" /> the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage warriors]], were highly skilled martial artists determined to defend the Kage people.<ref name=":1">{{SWE|1=locations|2=quarzite|3=Quarzite}}</ref> They pushed themselves to the utmost physical excellence, and were tireless, elite fighters, nimble and stealthy, and effective with the [[Electro sword/Legends|electro sword]] or unarmed.<ref name=":0" /> Riding atop multi-legged [[Milodon/Legends|milodons]], they could keep pace with the subtram transports.<ref name="Bounty" />

==History==
The Kage were native from [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]],<ref name="Bounty" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> notable for its strong [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressure.<ref name="Bounty" /> As result its inhospitable nature prevented it from truly flourishing as part of the galactic community. Underneath the surface, though, were immense crystalline cave networks of equalized pressure, where life could exist.<ref name=":1" /> The caverns of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] were home to the mysterious Kage.<ref name=":2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

An ongoing conflict between the outnumbered Kage and the powerful [[Belugan/Legends|Belugans]]<ref name=":0">{{SWE|groups|kagewarriors|Kage Warriors}}</ref> had been occourring by the times of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Bounty" /> The Kage had rebelled against the brutal rule of the [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] and staged raids from the backs of their [[Milodon/Legends|milodons]].<ref name=":2" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Bounty Date">{{FactFile2014|57|DEN 1-2|Dengar}}</ref> [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] kidnapped [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]], sister of the leader of [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]], to make her his bride. A group of mercenaries, including [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], was assembled to deliver the girl, closed in a box, to Blank's stronghold. In the [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|ensuing mission]] Ventress liberated Pluma and delivered her to his brother.<ref name="Bounty" />

==Behind the scenes==
Initially [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo]] and [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma]] were originally [[Human/Legends|humans]]<ref name="SW-Bounty - The Clone Wars Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep420|text="Bounty" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> instead of Kage as seen in the final TV episode.<ref name="Bounty" />
